rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
Power is the rate of doing work: P = dW/dt = F·v.
The SI unit of power is the watt (W): 1 W = 1 J/s.

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Power is based on fundamental principles.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: For constant force and velocity: P = Fv cos θ (dot product).  ·  Average power = total work / total time; instantaneous power = F·v at that instant.
